one_line: Voice-directed voxel world shared by a player and AI character.
what_it_does: Lets a person and agent inspect and reshape a live voxel island, including terrain, objects, characters, weather, dominoes, and preview commerce.
leverage_rationale: The live world context and typed world-editing actions make agent collaboration substantially more reliable than pixel-driven control.
leverage_evidence: Description exposes terrain, buildings, player position, actors, shops, camera state, and recent changes as structured context.
Claims reversible, interruptible world changes at the level of user intent.
execution_rationale: The packet describes a coherent, unusually broad game workflow and provides a live demo and frame-sheet references, but end-to-end execution evidence is limited in the supplied text.
execution_evidence: Live demo marked alive.
Claims visible terrain, object, character, weather, domino, and commerce state changes.
impact_rationale: Offers a credible playful audience value and a compelling collaborative game interaction, though the commerce and broad feature claims are less demonstrated.
impact_evidence: Player can direct construction and world changes by voice.
Interrupt and undo support user control.
creativity_rationale: A memorable synthesis of voxel play, voice-directed world authoring, shared agent state, and contextual commerce.
creativity_evidence: AI character Nika and human reshape the same persistent scene.
Intent-level commands can produce bridges, domino paths, terrain, weather, and storefront events.
usability_note: Intent-level voice commands and undo are promising, but breadth may make the interaction complex.

standouts: WebMCP is tied to world semantics rather than merely buttons.
advance_reason: High creativity and strong WebMCP-centered game premise warrant advancement despite limited execution evidence.

standouts: Visible agent activity and graph improve reviewability.

leverage_rationale: Cross-source normalized state and map-focused tools give agents precise investigative capabilities that are difficult to reproduce reliably from pixels and disconnected portals.
